query: In retail, shops need to allocate various types of products to different displays. The capacity limit of each display is provided in "capacity.csv", and the value and weight of each product are provided in "products.csv". The objective is to determine the optimal number of each product to place on each display so as to maximize the total value of all products placed across the displays, while ensuring that the total weight of the products on each display does not exceed its capacity. In addition, the total quantity of the first product placed across all displays must be at least 5. The decision variable x_{ij} represents the number of units of product j placed on display i.

query: Red Bean Clothing Factory produces various clothing products. The labor requirement, material requirement, selling price, and variable cost per unit for each product are provided in 41.csv. The factory has a weekly labor capacity of 1,650 units and a weekly material capacity of 1,850 units. It incurs a fixed operating cost of $4,500 per week regardless of production quantities. Determine the nonnegative continuous production quantity of each product that maximizes weekly net profit, defined as total sales revenue minus total variable cost minus the fixed weekly operating cost.

A consumer electronics factory operates an assembly line with three workstations and can produce 101 premium radio models: HiFi-1, HiFi-2, …, HiFi-101. The processing time required per unit of each model at each workstation is provided in workstation_times.csv. Each workstation has 1,440 minutes of total daily time. Daily maintenance consumes 10% of the available time at workstation 1, 14% at workstation 2, and 12% at workstation 3, so production may use only the remaining effective capacity of each workstation. Determine the nonnegative integer number of units of each radio model to produce per day so as to minimize total idle production time across the three workstations. For each workstation, idle time is its effective daily capacity minus the total processing time used at that workstation.

A large industrial factory plans monthly production for 111 products, P1 through P111. Producing each product requires processing time on 10 heavy machinery devices, A through J. The unit profit of each product is provided in unit_product_profits.csv, the processing time required by each product on each device is provided in device_time.csv, and the total monthly operating capacity of each device is provided in monthly_device_capacity.csv. Determine the nonnegative continuous production quantity of each product that maximizes total monthly profit while ensuring that the total processing time used on each device does not exceed that device's monthly capacity.
